# op_secret_ref (Ephemeral Resource)

Resolves a 1Password secret reference (`op://vault/item/field`) to its value at apply time. The value is never persisted to state or plan.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `reference` (String) Secret reference URI, e.g. `op://vault/item/field` or `op://vault/item/section/field`.

### Read-Only

- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The resolved secret value. Never persisted to state.
